common.title: Major Cyber Incident
common.line: A large, largely automated attack lands.

notable.title: Taiwan Blockade
notable.line: A quarantine or blockade halts advanced semiconductor exports.

notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Gigafactory siting backlash
notable.line: Municipal and regional opposition coalesces against gigafactory shortlist sites over power prices, water use and permitting, delaying grid-connection approvals in at least one shortlisted state.

notable.title: Grid disclosure cascade
notable.line: A major non-EU grid operator publicly discloses persistent model-assisted intrusions matching the autumn EU pattern, forcing coordinated cross-border attribution pressure.
